name: video-download
install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && uv sync --frozen

terminals.name: bot
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; if [ -n "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" ]; then uv run python bot.py; else echo 'TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is not set. Add it as a secret to run the Telegram bot. CLI (no token): uv run python main.py <url>'; fi
